Description: PNG image of the tissue section supplied as the Space Ranger alignment reference image, used to register the capture-area spot grid to the tissue for spatial gene expression analysis.
JPEG image of the tissue section supplied as the Space Ranger alignment reference image, used to register the capture-area spot grid to the tissue for spatial gene expression analysis.
JSON file output by Space Ranger (scalefactors_json.json) that records the scaling factors needed to relate spot positions to the full-resolution, high-resolution, and low-resolution tissue images.
CSV file listing the probe set used in a probe-based (e.g., FFPE) Visium assay, including probe IDs and the genes they target.
HTML quality-control report summarizing metrics from Space Ranger processing of a Visium sample, such as sequencing, alignment, and spatial coverage statistics.
Filtered feature-barcode expression matrix in Market Exchange (MEX) sparse-matrix format, containing only spots that Space Ranger called as being covered by tissue in a Visium sample.
Unfiltered feature-barcode expression matrix in Market Exchange (MEX) sparse-matrix format, containing all spots on the capture area regardless of tissue coverage, output by Space Ranger.

Space Ranger output file (tissue_positions.csv/.parquet) that maps each spot barcode to its row/column array coordinates and pixel coordinates on the full-resolution tissue image, and indicates whether the spot overlaps tissue.
Space Ranger output file (barcodes.tsv) listing the spot barcode sequences corresponding to the columns of the feature-barcode expression matrix.
Space Ranger output file (features.tsv) listing the gene/feature IDs and names corresponding to the rows of the feature-barcode expression matrix.
PNG image showing the fiducial frame (alignment markers) printed on the Visium slide, used by Space Ranger/Loupe Browser to register the capture area to the tissue image.
JPEG image showing the fiducial frame (alignment markers) printed on the Visium slide, used by Space Ranger/Loupe Browser to register the capture area to the tissue image.
PNG image output by Space Ranger showing the tissue area and spots detected during the tissue-detection step, overlaid on the slide image.
JPEG image output by Space Ranger showing the tissue area and spots detected during the tissue-detection step, overlaid on the slide image.
High-resolution tissue microscopy image (tissue_hires_image.png) bundled in Space Ranger spatial output, used for detailed visualization of the tissue section with the overlaid spot grid.

Low-resolution, downsampled tissue microscopy image (tissue_lowres_image.png) bundled in Space Ranger spatial output, used for lightweight visualization of the tissue section with the overlaid spot grid.
JSON file output by Space Ranger (scalefactors_json.json) that records the scaling factors needed to relate spot positions to the full-resolution, high-resolution, and low-resolution tissue images.
CSV file listing the probe set used in a probe-based (e.g., FFPE) Visium assay, including probe IDs and the genes they target.
